description:
Outer-planet missions (Jupiter/Saturn/Uranus/Neptune/Pluto) in /fly show 'NaN km/s' in the HUD velocity readout the entire flight

Expected: HUD displays a finite speed value in km/s for every mission, computed from vis-viva using the correct heliocentric transfer-ellipse semi-major axis for the actual destination

Acceptance criteria:
- heliocentricKms is a finite number (not NaN, not ±∞) at every simDay for a Jupiter-bound mission (galileo, juno, juice) [code-invariant: the app must not display NaN — the e2e test (fly-render-validation.spec.ts Layer 3 + Layer 4) already asserts 'All readouts are finite numbers (no NaN, no ±∞)' for Mars/Moon cases; the same invariant must hold for outer-planet missions]
- heliocentricKms is a finite number for a Saturn-bound mission (cassini, voyager-1) [code-invariant: same invariant as above]
- heliocentricKms is a finite number for an outer-system flyby (neptune: voyager-2, pluto: new-horizons, ceres: dawn) [code-invariant: same invariant as above]
- The transfer SMA in the vis-viva computation at line 952 of +page.svelte uses the Hohmann formula (R_EARTH_AU + DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a) / 2, replacing the Mars-only hardcoded (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2. DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a provides the destination's orbital SMA from planets.json via lambert-grid.constants.ts; the Hohmann transfer SMA formula a = (r1 + r2) / 2 is attested in the codebase as the transfer ellipse SMA construction [repo-data: mission-arc.ts line 169: 'const a = (r1 + r2) / 2' (transfer ellipse SMA formula); fly-render-validation.spec.ts line 40: 'const A_TRANSFER_MARS = (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2' (Mars-specific instance of the same pattern); DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a from lambert-grid.constants.ts lines 132-144 (per-destination orbital SMA values sourced from planets.json)]

Domain facts:
- Jupiter a=5.20336 AU, Saturn a=9.53707 AU, Uranus a=19.19126 AU, Neptune a=30.06896 AU, Pluto a=39.482 AU (from planets.json / small-bodies.json via lambert-grid.constants.ts DESTINATIONS map)
- The vis-viva equation v = sqrt(µ · (2/r - 1/a)) produces NaN when r > 2a (the argument becomes negative)
- The Hohmann transfer SMA is (r_Earth + r_dest) / 2 — attested in mission-arc.ts:169 ('const a = (r1 + r2) / 2') and fly-render-validation.spec.ts:40 ('const A_TRANSFER_MARS = (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2')
- DESTINATIONS and activeDestination are both accessible at line 952 — DESTINATIONS is imported at line 65, activeDestination is a $state<DestinationId> at line 300
